metadata.name: marco_spot
metadata.description: Marco Spot Stocks — custodian-backed HKEX equity positions settled in stablecoins on Solana

docs: Marco Spot Stocks.
One market per HKEX-listed security. Traders buy with stablecoins; a
licensed conversion partner crosses to HKD, an SFC-licensed broker buys
the real share on HKEX as principal, and a regulated custodian holds it
1:1 in segregated custody. Only once that holding is attested on-chain is
a position token minted — so supply tracks custodied shares, not intent.
In Phase 1 the position token is non-transferable, locked to the holder's
wallet. Phase 2 lifts the lock into a freely tradable, composable token.

instructions.name: cancel_buy
docs: Cancel a buy and refund the trader. Pending (trader or admin) or
Deployed (admin only, after a failed off-chain leg returns funds).

accounts.name: trader_usdc
docs: Refund always goes to the order's own trader.

instructions.name: cancel_sell
docs: Cancel a pending sell and return the escrowed position tokens.

accounts.name: trader_position
docs: Tokens always return to the order's own trader.

instructions.name: confirm_buy
docs: Attest the custodied position and mint the trader's position tokens.
Deployed -> Filled. The only path that creates position tokens.

accounts.name: trader_position
docs: The order's own trader receives the position — never an arbitrary
account supplied by the caller.

instructions.name: deploy_buy
docs: Send the escrowed stablecoins to the immutable conversion-partner
account and take the trading spread. Pending -> Deployed.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Must be the market's immutable settlement destination.

instructions.name: initialize_market
docs: Create a market for one security. PDA seeds: [b"market", admin, ticker].
`settlement_destination` (the conversion partner) is fixed here forever.

accounts.name: position_mint
docs: Position-token mint. The market PDA is both mint and freeze
authority — minting is gated on a custody attestation, and the
freeze authority is what locks positions in Phase 1.

accounts.name: market_usdc
docs: Stablecoin escrow, owned by the market PDA.

accounts.name: position_escrow
docs: Holds position tokens escrowed against pending sells. Never frozen,
so escrowed tokens can be burned at settlement or returned on cancel.

accounts.name: settlement_destination
docs: IMMUTABLE conversion-partner USDC account. Only its key is stored;
it is validated as a token account when capital is deployed.

instructions.name: place_buy
docs: Submit a buy: escrow stablecoins and open an order. Nothing is
deployed and no position exists yet.
`min_shares_out` is mandatory slippage protection — a price cap alone
does not constrain how many shares come back.

accounts.name: trader_account
docs: Eligibility is keyed by the market's admin, so one verification
covers every market in the deployment.

instructions.name: place_sell
docs: Submit a sell: escrow position tokens while the broker sells the
underlying. Tokens are burned at settlement, not here.

instructions.name: register_trader
docs: Record a trader's eligibility after off-chain identity verification.
Keyed by admin, so one verification covers every market.

instructions.name: set_fee_bps
docs: Adjust the trading spread, within the hard cap.

instructions.name: set_market_status
docs: Open, pause or close the market. A HK trading halt maps to Paused.

instructions.name: set_transfer_lock
docs: Lock/unlock position tokens — the Phase 1 to Phase 2 switch. Clearing
it stops new freezes; existing accounts still need `unlock_position`.

instructions.name: settle_sell
docs: Settle a sell: burn the escrowed tokens and pay the trader the
proceeds net of the spread. Pending -> Settled.

accounts.name: trader_usdc
docs: Proceeds always go to the order's own trader.

instructions.name: sweep_fee
docs: Sweep collected trading spread to the treasury.

instructions.name: unlock_position
docs: Thaw one holder's position once the transfer lock has been lifted.
Permissionless — it only works after admin unlocks.

accounts.name: holder_position
docs: Constrained to this market's position mint, so the instruction can
never touch an unrelated token account.

instructions.name: update_operator
docs: Rotate the operator wallet.

types.name: BuyCancelled
docs: A buy was cancelled and the stablecoins returned. Cancelled while Pending
refunds in full; cancelled while Deployed also reverses the spread.

fields.name: was_deployed
docs: True when the cancel asserted a failed off-chain leg (admin only).

types.name: BuyPlaced
docs: Events for the four trader-initiated instructions.
These exist for the off-chain orchestrator, which creates every intent from
an observed chain event and never from an HTTP call — the on-chain escrow
*is* the authorisation. A trader whose USDC is not locked in the market
escrow has not agreed to anything, so the escrow event is the only thing
that may start work on their behalf.
Operator transitions (`deploy_buy`, `confirm_buy`, `settle_sell`) are
deliberately not emitted. The operator submits those itself and already
knows the outcome; only trader actions arrive unannounced.
Each event carries `ticker` alongside the market pubkey. The orchestrator
keys markets by that string, and including it saves an account read per
event on a hot polling path.
A trader escrowed USDC and opened a buy.

fields.name: usdc_amount
docs: USDC moved into the market escrow.

fields.name: limit_price
docs: Per-share limit the trader agreed to. A fill may never be attested
worse than this.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Spread snapshotted at placement — a later `set_fee_bps` must not
re-price an order already in flight.

types.name: Holding
docs: Cumulative per-trader record for one market. The position token balance
is the live position; this is the running history used for reconciliation
against the custodian's statements.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: admin
docs: Controlling authority — expected to be a Squads multisig PDA.

fields.name: operator
docs: Operator wallet — may deploy capital and confirm fills.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Treasury wallet — receives swept trading-spread fees.

fields.name: settlement_destination
docs: IMMUTABLE conversion-partner USDC account. Escrowed stablecoins
can only ever be sent here. Set once at creation, never mutated.

fields.name: position_mint
docs: SPL mint for this market's position token.

fields.name: market_usdc
docs: The market's USDC account (PDA, owned by the market).

fields.name: position_escrow
docs: Position tokens escrowed against pending sells (PDA, market-owned).

fields.name: ticker
docs: HKEX ticker, e.g. "0700.HK".

fields.name: status
docs: Whether the market is accepting new orders.

fields.name: transfer_lock
docs: Phase 1: position tokens are frozen in the holder's wallet on mint.
Phase 2: admin clears this and holders thaw via `unlock_position`.

fields.name: share_decimals
docs: Decimals on the position token. Matches USDC (6) so fractional
share quantities are expressible.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Trading spread charged in-contract, in basis points.

fields.name: min_order_usdc
docs: Minimum USDC a single buy must intend (anti-dust).

fields.name: max_order_usdc
docs: Maximum USDC for a single buy (0 = no limit).

fields.name: total_shares_outstanding
docs: Position tokens minted and outstanding. Reconciles 1:1 against the
shares the custodian reports holding.

fields.name: usdc_escrowed
docs: USDC held against Pending buy orders (not yet deployed).

fields.name: shares_escrowed
docs: Position tokens held against Pending sell orders.

fields.name: total_deployed
docs: USDC sent to the conversion partner over the market's life.

fields.name: total_bought_usdc
docs: Lifetime USDC spent on filled buys (net of fee).

fields.name: total_sold_usdc
docs: Lifetime USDC paid out on settled sells (net of fee).

fields.name: fees_collected
docs: Trading spread collected, awaiting sweep.

fields.name: fees_swept
docs: Trading spread swept to treasury.

fields.name: order_seq
docs: Monotonic order counter — seeds the per-order PDA.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix ts the market was created.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved for forward-compatible upgrades.

types.name: MarketParams
docs: Market parameters, fixed at creation.

fields.name: ticker
docs: HKEX ticker, e.g. "0700.HK".

fields.name: share_decimals
docs: Decimals on the position token; 6 matches USDC.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Trading spread in basis points.

fields.name: max_order_usdc
docs: 0 = no per-order maximum.

types.name: MarketStatus
docs: Whether a market is accepting new orders.
A Hong Kong trading halt maps to `Paused`: no new orders are taken,
but orders already in flight can still settle or be cancelled, so a
halt never strands capital that has already left a wallet.

fields.name: order_id
docs: Monotonic id within the market; part of the order PDA seeds.

fields.name: usdc_amount
docs: Buy: USDC escrowed at submission (gross, fee inclusive).
Sell: USDC paid out at settlement (net of fee).

fields.name: shares_amount
docs: Buy: shares minted at fill. Sell: shares escrowed at submission.

fields.name: limit_price
docs: Buy: highest acceptable price per share. Sell: lowest acceptable.
Enforced against the attested execution price.

fields.name: min_shares_out
docs: Buy only: the fewest shares the trader will accept for their capital.
`limit_price` caps what each share may cost but says nothing about
how many arrive, so without this a fill could convert the whole
deployment into a token dust position. Must be non-zero.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Spread rate snapshotted when the order was placed, so a later
`set_fee_bps` cannot re-price an order already in flight.

fields.name: execution_price
docs: Attested execution price per share.

fields.name: fee_paid
docs: Trading spread charged on this order.

fields.name: deployed_amount
docs: Buy: USDC actually sent to the conversion partner.

fields.name: custody_ref
docs: Custodian's reference for the resulting position.

fields.name: doc_hash
docs: Fingerprint of the broker confirmation + custodian statement. The
documents stay off-chain; publishing only the hash lets a holder
verify a document they are shown is genuine without exposing
counterparty paperwork.

types.name: OrderStatus
docs: Order lifecycle. Buys and sells share the enum but walk different paths:
```text
Buy:   Pending ─deploy_buy─▶ Deployed ─confirm_buy─▶ Filled
Sell:  Pending ─settle_sell──────────────────────▶ Settled
└─ cancel_sell ─▶ Cancelled

types.name: SellCancelled
docs: A pending sell was cancelled and the escrowed position returned intact.

types.name: SellPlaced
docs: A trader escrowed position tokens and opened a sell.
The tokens are escrowed, not burned: while the broker is selling, the
custodian still holds the share, so supply should still reflect it.

types.name: TraderAccount
docs: Per-trader eligibility record.
Keyed by `admin` rather than by market, so a trader is verified once
for the whole deployment rather than per security. Marco sets this
after off-chain identity verification; the program only reads the flag.

fields.name: admin
docs: The authority that vouched for this trader.

fields.name: trader
docs: The trader's wallet.

fields.name: eligible
docs: Whether the trader may place orders. Revocable.

fields.name: jurisdiction
docs: ISO 3166-1 numeric country code, for jurisdiction gating off-chain.
0 when unset.
